```{r analysis-functions, include=FALSE}
# Q2 association and prediction analysis. No source file is modified.
# All analysis functions are included directly in this R Markdown document.

q2_make_proxy <- function(fat1, sugar1, energy1, recall1,
                          fat2, sugar2, energy2, recall2) {
  stopifnot(length(unique(lengths(list(fat1,sugar1,energy1,recall1,
    fat2,sugar2,energy2,recall2))))==1L)
  daily <- function(fat, sugar, energy, recall) {
    recorded <- recall %in% 1:7
    positive_energy <- is.finite(energy) & energy>0
    components <- is.finite(fat) & fat>=0 & fat<=100 &
      is.finite(sugar) & sugar>=0 & sugar<=100 & fat+sugar<=100
    valid <- recorded & positive_energy & components
    list(valid=valid, value=ifelse(valid,fat+sugar,NA_real_),
      status=ifelse(!recorded,"No recorded recall",
        ifelse(!positive_energy,"No positive energy",
          ifelse(!components,"Invalid nutrient percentages","Valid"))))
  }
  first <- daily(fat1,sugar1,energy1,recall1)
  second <- daily(fat2,sugar2,energy2,recall2)
  # Day 1 is mandatory. An unavailable Day 2 never contributes a placeholder 0.
  # This is an equal-day mean, NOT an energy-weighted pooled percentage.
  # SATPER already includes trans fat; genuine nutrient zeros remain valid.
  proxy <- ifelse(first$valid,
    ifelse(second$valid,(first$value+second$value)/2,first$value),NA_real_)
  data.frame(day1_valid=first$valid,day2_valid=second$valid,
    proxy_day1_pct=first$value,proxy_day2_pct=second$value,
    upf_nutrient_proxy_pct=proxy,upf_nutrient_proxy_pct10=proxy/10,
    proxy_days=ifelse(first$valid,ifelse(second$valid,2L,1L),0L),
    day2_status=second$status,
    proxy_source=ifelse(!first$valid,"Unavailable: invalid Day 1",
      ifelse(second$valid,"Mean of two valid days","Day 1 only")))
}

q2_read_data <- function(data_dir) {
  paths <- file.path(data_dir, c("AHSnpa11bp.csv", "AHSnpa11bb.csv"))
  stopifnot(all(file.exists(paths)))
  before <- unname(tools::md5sum(paths))
  reps <- sprintf("RPWGT%02d", 1:60)
  p <- as.data.frame(data.table::fread(paths[1], select=c("ABSPID", "ABSHID",
    "AGEC", "SEX", "FEMLSBC", "BMICATHY", "ENERGYF1", "ENERGYF2",
    "SATPER1", "SATPER2", "PEADDSD1", "PEADDSD2", "NUTDAY1", "NUTDAY2")))
  b <- as.data.frame(data.table::fread(paths[2], select=c("ABSPID", "VDLCMRGT",
    "VDLCMREB", "DIABPRVE", "NHMSPERW", reps)))
  stopifnot(!anyNA(p$ABSPID), !anyNA(b$ABSPID), !anyDuplicated(p$ABSPID),
    !anyDuplicated(b$ABSPID), setequal(p$ABSPID, b$ABSPID))
  d <- cbind(p, b[match(p$ABSPID, b$ABSPID), setdiff(names(b), "ABSPID")])
  d$source_row_id <- seq_len(nrow(d))
  d$household_id <- as.character(d$ABSHID)
  stopifnot(!anyNA(d$household_id), all(nzchar(d$household_id)))
  d$age <- d$AGEC
  d$sex <- factor(ifelse(d$SEX %in% 1:2, d$SEX, NA), 1:2, c("Male", "Female"))
  d$pregnancy <- ifelse(d$SEX == 1, "Not pregnant",
    ifelse(d$SEX == 2 & d$FEMLSBC == 2, "Pregnant",
      ifelse(d$SEX == 2 & d$FEMLSBC %in% c(1, 3:6), "Not pregnant", "Unknown")))
  d$eligible <- d$age %in% 18:64 & d$pregnancy == "Not pregnant"
  d$obese <- ifelse(d$BMICATHY %in% 7:9, 1L,
    ifelse(d$BMICATHY %in% 1:6, 0L, NA_integer_))
  d$vitamin_d <- factor(ifelse(d$VDLCMRGT %in% 1:3, d$VDLCMRGT, NA), 1:3,
    c("Adequate", "Mild deficiency", "Moderate/severe deficiency"))
  d$vitamin_d_binary <- factor(ifelse(d$VDLCMRGT == 1, "Adequate",
    ifelse(d$VDLCMRGT %in% 2:3, "Deficient", NA)), c("Adequate", "Deficient"))
  d$diabetes <- factor(ifelse(d$DIABPRVE %in% 1:2, "Diabetes",
    ifelse(d$DIABPRVE %in% 3:4, "No diabetes", NA)), c("No diabetes", "Diabetes"))
  d <- cbind(d,q2_make_proxy(d$SATPER1,d$PEADDSD1,d$ENERGYF1,d$NUTDAY1,
    d$SATPER2,d$PEADDSD2,d$ENERGYF2,d$NUTDAY2))
  d$weight <- d$NHMSPERW
  d$weight_ok <- is.finite(d$weight) & d$weight > 0
  base_vars <- c("obese", "vitamin_d", "age", "sex")
  d$exposure_complete <- d$eligible & d$weight_ok &
    complete.cases(d[, c(base_vars, "upf_nutrient_proxy_pct10")])
  d$main_complete <- d$exposure_complete & !is.na(d$diabetes)
  # All main model comparisons and the secondary interaction use one sample.
  d$interaction_complete <- d$main_complete
  d$joint_complete <- d$main_complete
  d$two_day_complete <- d$main_complete & d$proxy_days==2L
  stopifnot(nrow(d)==nrow(p), identical(d$ABSPID, p$ABSPID),
    identical(before, unname(tools::md5sum(paths))))
  flow <- data.frame(stage=c("All source participants", "Aged 18-64",
    "Known non-pregnant, aged 18-64", "Measured BMI category available",
    "Vitamin D, combined proxy, age, sex and positive biomedical weight",
    "Diabetes also available: final common analysis sample"),
    n=c(nrow(d), sum(d$age %in% 18:64), sum(d$eligible),
      sum(d$eligible & !is.na(d$obese)), sum(d$exposure_complete), sum(d$main_complete)))
  flow$excluded_at_step <- c(0, -diff(flow$n))
  e <- d[d$eligible, ]
  missing <- data.frame(variable=c("Measured obesity", "Blood vitamin D",
    "Combined nutrient proxy", "Usable Day 2 (optional)", "Diabetes",
    "Positive biomedical weight"), missing_n=c(sum(is.na(e$obese)),
    sum(is.na(e$vitamin_d)), sum(is.na(e$upf_nutrient_proxy_pct10)), sum(!e$day2_valid),
    sum(is.na(e$diabetes)), sum(!e$weight_ok)))
  missing$eligible_n <- nrow(e)
  missing$missing_pct <- 100*missing$missing_n/nrow(e)
  pregnancy <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("Not pregnant", "Pregnant", "Unknown"), function(z) {
    x <- d[d$age %in% 18:64 & d$pregnancy == z, ]
    data.frame(pregnancy=z, n=nrow(x), measured_bmi_n=sum(!is.na(x$obese)))
  }))
  availability <- do.call(rbind,lapply(c("All source participants",
    "Eligible non-pregnant adults", "Main Q2 sample"),function(label) {
    x <- switch(label,"All source participants"=d,
      "Eligible non-pregnant adults"=e,"Main Q2 sample"=d[d$main_complete,])
    data.frame(sample=label,n=nrow(x),both_days=sum(x$day1_valid & x$day2_valid),
      day1_only=sum(x$day1_valid & !x$day2_valid),
      day2_only=sum(!x$day1_valid & x$day2_valid),neither=sum(!x$day1_valid & !x$day2_valid))
  }))
  list(data=d, paths=paths, hashes=before, reps=reps, flow=flow,
    missingness=missing, pregnancy=pregnancy,proxy_availability=availability)
}

q2_design <- function(d, reps) {
  full <- d[d$weight_ok, ]
  rw <- as.matrix(full[, reps])
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(rw)), all(rw>=0), ncol(rw)==60)
  survey::svrepdesign(data=full, weights=~weight, repweights=rw,
    combined.weights=TRUE, type="other", scale=59/60,
    rscales=rep(1, 60), mse=TRUE)
}

q2_prevalence <- function(design, label) {
  x <- survey::svymean(~obese, design)
  p <- unname(coef(x)); se <- unname(survey::SE(x))
  df <- survey::degf(design)
  ci <- plogis(qlogis(p)+c(-1,1)*qt(.975, df)*se/(p*(1-p)))
  d <- design$variables
  data.frame(analysis=label, n=nrow(d), obese_n=sum(d$obese),
    not_obese_n=sum(d$obese==0), unweighted_pct=100*mean(d$obese),
    weighted_pct=100*p, low=100*ci[1], high=100*ci[2], df=df)
}

q2_term_test <- function(model, term, label) {
  z <- survey::regTermTest(model, stats::as.formula(paste("~", term)), method="Wald")
  data.frame(test=label, F=as.numeric(z$Ftest), numerator_df=z$df,
    denominator_df=z$ddf, p_value=as.numeric(z$p))
}

q2_contrast <- function(model, L, label, exponentiate=TRUE) {
  stopifnot(length(L)==length(coef(model)))
  estimate <- sum(L*coef(model))
  se <- sqrt(drop(t(L) %*% vcov(model) %*% L))
  df <- model$df.residual
  ci <- estimate+c(-1, 1)*qt(.975, df)*se
  data.frame(contrast=label, estimate=if(exponentiate) exp(estimate) else estimate,
    low=if(exponentiate) exp(ci[1]) else ci[1],
    high=if(exponentiate) exp(ci[2]) else ci[2], log_estimate=estimate,
    SE=se, df=df, p_value=2*pt(abs(estimate/se), df, lower.tail=FALSE))
}

q2_or_table <- function(model) {
  terms <- names(coef(model))[-1]
  do.call(rbind, lapply(terms, function(term) {
    L <- setNames(rep(0, length(coef(model))), names(coef(model)))
    L[term] <- if(term=="age") 10 else 1
    label <- switch(term, upf_nutrient_proxy_pct10="Combined nutrient proxy: +10 energy percentage points",
      age="Age: +10 years",
      diabetesDiabetes="Diabetes versus no diabetes",
      sexFemale="Female versus male", term)
    q2_contrast(model, L, label)
  }))
}

q2_rcs_nonlinear <- function(x, knots) {
  # Harrell restricted cubic basis: explicit x belongs in the model separately.
  # Four fixed knots yield TWO nonlinear columns, avoiding x + ns(x) aliasing.
  stopifnot(length(knots)==4L, all(diff(knots)>0))
  h <- function(z) pmax(z, 0)^3
  a <- knots[3]; b <- knots[4]
  sapply(knots[1:2], function(t) (h(x-t)-h(x-a)*(b-t)/(b-a)+
    h(x-b)*(a-t)/(b-a))/(b-knots[1])^2)
}

q2_nonlinearity <- function(design) {
  d <- design$variables
  predictors <- c("upf_nutrient_proxy_pct10", "age")
  knots <- lapply(d[predictors], quantile, probs=c(.05, .35, .65, .95), names=FALSE)
  nonlinear <- character()
  for(v in predictors) {
    b <- q2_rcs_nonlinear(d[[v]], knots[[v]])
    nm <- paste0(v, "_nl", 1:2)
    design$variables[, nm] <- b
    nonlinear <- c(nonlinear, nm)
  }
  f <- reformulate(c("diabetes", "vitamin_d", predictors, "sex", nonlinear), "obese")
  mm <- model.matrix(f, design$variables)
  stopifnot(qr(mm)$rank == ncol(mm))
  model <- survey::svyglm(f, design=design, family=quasibinomial())
  tests <- do.call(rbind, lapply(predictors, function(v)
    q2_term_test(model, paste(paste0(v,"_nl",1:2), collapse=" + "),
      paste("Nonlinearity:", v))))
  tests$p_holm <- p.adjust(tests$p_value, "holm")
  global <- q2_term_test(model, paste(nonlinear, collapse=" + "), "Any nonlinearity")
  global$p_holm <- NA_real_
  list(model=model, tests=rbind(global, tests), knots=do.call(rbind,
    lapply(predictors, function(v) data.frame(variable=v, knot=1:4, value=knots[[v]]))))
}

q2_gam_formula <- function(interaction=FALSE, nutrients=TRUE, k=6) {
  s <- mgcv::s
  lhs <- if(interaction) "vitamin_d_binary * diabetes" else "diabetes + vitamin_d"
  rhs <- c(lhs, if(nutrients) sprintf("s(upf_nutrient_proxy_pct10, k=%d, bs='cr')", k),
    sprintf("s(age, k=%d, bs='cr')", k), "sex")
  stats::as.formula(paste("obese ~", paste(rhs, collapse=" + ")), env=environment())
}

q2_gam_bundle <- function(d, reps, formula, k=6, label="GAM") {
  numeric_vars <- intersect(c("upf_nutrient_proxy_pct10", "age"), all.vars(formula))
  knots <- lapply(d[numeric_vars], quantile, probs=seq(0,1,length.out=k), names=FALSE)
  stopifnot(all(vapply(knots, function(x) length(unique(x))==k, logical(1))))
  fit <- function(w) {
    fit_data <- d
    fit_data$.fit_weight <- w/mean(w)
    ans <- mgcv::gam(formula, data=fit_data, family=quasibinomial(),
      weights=.fit_weight, method="REML", knots=knots, drop.unused.levels=FALSE)
    stopifnot(isTRUE(ans$converged), all(is.finite(coef(ans))))
    if(!is.null(ans$outer.info$conv) && ans$outer.info$conv!="full convergence")
      stop("GAM smoothing optimisation failed: ", ans$outer.info$conv)
    ans
  }
  full <- fit(d$weight)
  beta <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow=length(coef(full)), ncol=60,
    dimnames=list(names(coef(full)), reps))
  for(r in seq_along(reps)) {
    if(r %% 10 == 0) message(label, ": survey replicate ", r, "/60")
    z <- fit(d[[reps[r]]])
    stopifnot(identical(names(coef(z)), rownames(beta)))
    # Identical data, fixed knots and basis dimension preserve coefficient basis.
    check_rows <- seq_len(min(8, nrow(d)))
    stopifnot(max(abs(predict(full, d[check_rows,], type="lpmatrix") -
      predict(z, d[check_rows,], type="lpmatrix"))) < 1e-8)
    beta[,r] <- coef(z)
  }
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(beta)))
  list(model=full, coefficients=cbind(full=coef(full), beta),
    weights=cbind(full=d$weight, as.matrix(d[,reps])), kind="gam")
}

q2_logit_bundle <- function(model, d, reps) {
  beta <- t(as.matrix(model$replicates))
  stopifnot(nrow(beta)==length(coef(model)), ncol(beta)==60,
    all(is.finite(beta)))
  # survey versions may omit replicate coefficient names. In that case verify
  # the model-matrix order and independently refit one replicate before naming.
  if(is.null(rownames(beta))) {
    stopifnot(identical(colnames(model.matrix(model)),names(coef(model))))
    audit_data <- d
    audit_data$.q2_rep_weight <- d[[reps[1]]]/mean(d[[reps[1]]])
    audit <- glm(formula(model),data=audit_data,weights=.q2_rep_weight,
      family=quasibinomial(),start=coef(model))
    stopifnot(max(abs(unname(coef(audit))-beta[,1])) < 1e-5)
    rownames(beta) <- names(coef(model))
  }
  stopifnot(setequal(rownames(beta),names(coef(model))))
  beta <- beta[names(coef(model)),,drop=FALSE]
  list(model=model, coefficients=cbind(full=coef(model), beta),
    weights=cbind(full=d$weight, as.matrix(d[,reps])), kind="glm")
}

q2_standardise <- function(bundle, d, scenarios) {
  # Each column uses its own replicate's model AND averaging weights.
  vapply(scenarios, function(changes) {
    nd <- d
    for(v in names(changes)) {
      nd[[v]] <- if(is.factor(d[[v]])) factor(rep(changes[[v]],nrow(d)),
        levels=levels(d[[v]])) else rep(changes[[v]], nrow(d))
    }
    X <- if(bundle$kind=="gam") predict(bundle$model, nd, type="lpmatrix") else
      model.matrix(delete.response(terms(bundle$model)), nd,
        contrasts.arg=bundle$model$contrasts, xlev=bundle$model$xlevels)
    X <- X[, rownames(bundle$coefficients), drop=FALSE]
    pp <- plogis(X %*% bundle$coefficients)
    colSums(pp*bundle$weights)/colSums(bundle$weights)
  }, numeric(61))
}

q2_replicate_ci <- function(estimates, df, transform=c("identity", "logit")) {
  transform <- match.arg(transform)
  if(is.null(dim(estimates))) estimates <- matrix(estimates, ncol=1)
  stopifnot(nrow(estimates)==61L, all(is.finite(estimates)))
  if(transform=="logit" && any(estimates<=0 | estimates>=1))
    stop("A probability CI is on the boundary; combine sparse display groups rather than clipping.")
  z <- if(transform=="logit") qlogis(estimates) else estimates
  se <- sqrt((59/60)*colSums(sweep(z[-1,,drop=FALSE],2,z[1,],"-")^2))
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(z)),all(is.finite(se)))
  lo <- z[1,]-qt(.975,df)*se; hi <- z[1,]+qt(.975,df)*se
  data.frame(estimate=estimates[1,], low=if(transform=="logit") plogis(lo) else lo,
    high=if(transform=="logit") plogis(hi) else hi, SE_transformed=se, df=df)
}

q2_main_curves <- function(d, linear, gam, df) {
  specs <- list(); meta <- list()
  for(v in c("upf_nutrient_proxy_pct10", "age")) {
    grid <- seq(quantile(d[[v]],.05), quantile(d[[v]],.95), length.out=25)
    for(x in grid) {
      specs[[length(specs)+1]] <- setNames(list(x),v)
      meta[[length(meta)+1]] <- data.frame(variable=v, value=x)
    }
  }
  meta <- do.call(rbind, meta)
  curves <- do.call(rbind,lapply(c("Logistic", "GAM"),function(name) {
    est <- q2_standardise(if(name=="GAM") gam else linear,d,specs)
    cbind(model=name,meta,q2_replicate_ci(est,df,"logit"))
  }))
  curves$value <- ifelse(curves$variable=="age",curves$value,curves$value*10)
  vd <- lapply(levels(d$vitamin_d), function(z) list(vitamin_d=z))
  vitamin <- do.call(rbind,lapply(c("Logistic", "GAM"),function(name) {
    est <- q2_standardise(if(name=="GAM") gam else linear,d,vd)
    cbind(model=name,vitamin_d=levels(d$vitamin_d),q2_replicate_ci(est,df,"logit"))
  }))
  list(curves=curves, vitamin=vitamin)
}

q2_diabetes_results <- function(design, joint_design, reps) {
  d <- design$variables
  formula <- obese ~ vitamin_d_binary * diabetes + upf_nutrient_proxy_pct10 + age + sex
  primary <- survey::svyglm(formula,design=design,family=quasibinomial(),return.replicates=TRUE)
  primary_bundle <- q2_logit_bundle(primary,d,reps)
  gam <- q2_gam_bundle(d,reps,q2_gam_formula(TRUE,TRUE),label="Diabetes GAM")
  tests <- q2_term_test(primary,"vitamin_d_binary:diabetes","Proxy-adjusted logistic interaction")
  # A model-based GAM coefficient is tested with survey-replicate covariance.
  nm <- grep(":",rownames(gam$coefficients),value=TRUE)
  stopifnot(length(nm)==1L)
  z <- gam$coefficients[nm,]
  se <- sqrt((59/60)*sum((z[-1]-z[1])^2))
  df <- survey::degf(design)
  gam_test <- data.frame(test="GAM interaction (replicate-based, approximate)",
    F=(z[1]/se)^2,numerator_df=1,denominator_df=df,
    p_value=pf((z[1]/se)^2,1,df,lower.tail=FALSE))
  tests <- rbind(tests,gam_test)
  terms <- names(coef(primary))
  vdterm <- "vitamin_d_binaryDeficient"
  interterm <- grep(":",terms,value=TRUE)
  contrasts <- lapply(c("No diabetes", "Diabetes", "Ratio of odds ratios"),function(g) {
    L <- setNames(rep(0,length(terms)),terms)
    if(g!="Ratio of odds ratios") L[vdterm] <- 1
    if(g!="No diabetes") L[interterm] <- 1
    q2_contrast(primary,L,g)
  })
  combos <- expand.grid(vitamin_d_binary=c("Adequate","Deficient"),
    diabetes=c("No diabetes","Diabetes"),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  scenarios <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(combos)),function(i) as.list(combos[i,]))
  probs <- list(Logistic=q2_standardise(primary_bundle,d,scenarios),
    GAM=q2_standardise(gam,d,scenarios))
  prevalences <- do.call(rbind,lapply(names(probs),function(m)
    cbind(model=m,combos,q2_replicate_ci(probs[[m]],df,"logit"))))
  differences <- do.call(rbind,lapply(names(probs),function(m) {
    x <- probs[[m]]
    est <- cbind(x[,2]-x[,1],x[,4]-x[,3],(x[,4]-x[,3])-(x[,2]-x[,1]))
    cbind(model=m,contrast=c("Deficient - adequate: no diabetes",
      "Deficient - adequate: diabetes", "Difference in prevalence differences"),
      q2_replicate_ci(est,df,"identity"))
  }))
  cells <- aggregate(cbind(n=rep(1,nrow(d)),obese_n=d$obese),
    d[c("diabetes","vitamin_d_binary")],sum)
  cells$not_obese_n <- cells$n-cells$obese_n
  stopifnot(identical(d$source_row_id,joint_design$variables$source_row_id))
  matched <- survey::svyglm(update(formula,.~.-upf_nutrient_proxy_pct10),
    design=joint_design,family=quasibinomial())
  sensitivity <- rbind(q2_term_test(matched,"vitamin_d_binary:diabetes",
    "Same sample, no-proxy sensitivity"),q2_term_test(primary,"vitamin_d_binary:diabetes",
    "Same sample, primary proxy-adjusted model"))
  list(primary=primary,gam=gam,tests=tests,odds=do.call(rbind,contrasts),
    prevalences=prevalences,differences=differences,cells=cells,sensitivity=sensitivity)
}

q2_compute_associations <- function(data_dir) {
  input <- q2_read_data(data_dir)
  full <- q2_design(input$data,input$reps)
  main <- subset(full,main_complete)
  subgroup <- subset(full,interaction_complete)
  joint <- subset(full,joint_complete)
  d <- main$variables
  model <- survey::svyglm(obese ~ diabetes+vitamin_d+upf_nutrient_proxy_pct10+age+sex,
    design=main,family=quasibinomial(),return.replicates=TRUE)
  stopifnot(model$converged,all(is.finite(coef(model))))
  tests <- do.call(rbind,lapply(c("vitamin_d","upf_nutrient_proxy_pct10"),function(v)
    q2_term_test(model,v,paste("Adjusted association:",v))))
  tests$p_holm <- p.adjust(tests$p_value,"holm")
  linear <- q2_logit_bundle(model,d,input$reps)
  nonlinear <- q2_nonlinearity(main)
  gam <- q2_gam_bundle(d,input$reps,q2_gam_formula(),label="Main GAM")
  display <- q2_main_curves(d,linear,gam,survey::degf(main))
  interaction <- q2_diabetes_results(subgroup,joint,input$reps)
  samples <- rbind(q2_prevalence(main,"Diabetes-adjusted association and prediction"),
    q2_prevalence(subgroup,"Proxy-adjusted diabetes interaction"),
    q2_prevalence(joint,"Same-sample no-proxy interaction sensitivity"),
    q2_prevalence(subset(full,two_day_complete),"Two-valid-day sensitivity"))
  two_day_design <- subset(full,two_day_complete)
  two_day_model <- survey::svyglm(formula(model),design=two_day_design,family=quasibinomial())
  stopifnot(two_day_model$converged,all(is.finite(coef(two_day_model))))
  sensitivity_odds <- do.call(rbind,lapply(c("Main: Day 1 fallback","Two valid days only"),function(label) {
    fit <- if(label=="Main: Day 1 fallback") model else two_day_model
    rows <- q2_or_table(fit)
    rows <- rows[grepl("^vitamin_d|^Combined nutrient",rows$contrast),]
    cbind(analysis=label,n=if(label=="Main: Day 1 fallback") nrow(d) else nrow(two_day_design$variables),rows)
  }))
  proxy_usage <- as.data.frame(table(source=d$proxy_source),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  names(proxy_usage)[2] <- "n"
  proxy_usage$percent <- 100*proxy_usage$n/nrow(d)
  fallback_reasons <- as.data.frame(table(reason=d$day2_status[d$proxy_days==1L]),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  names(fallback_reasons)[2] <- "n"
  detail <- summary(gam$model)$s.table
  smooths <- data.frame(term=rownames(detail),edf=detail[,"edf"],row.names=NULL)
  set.seed(3888)
  kc <- mgcv::k.check(gam$model,n.rep=200)
  diagnostics <- data.frame(term=rownames(kc),basis_dimension=kc[,1],edf=kc[,2],
    k_index=kc[,3],row.names=NULL) # no ordinary iid p-values reported
  conc <- mgcv::concurvity(gam$model,full=TRUE)
  concurvity <- data.frame(term=colnames(conc),worst=conc["worst",],
    observed=conc["observed",],estimate=conc["estimate",],row.names=NULL)
  summary_numeric <- do.call(rbind,lapply(c("upf_nutrient_proxy_pct","age"),function(v)
    data.frame(variable=v,n=nrow(d),mean=mean(d[[v]]),sd=sd(d[[v]]),
      p05=quantile(d[[v]],.05),median=median(d[[v]]),p95=quantile(d[[v]],.95))))
  list(input=input,main_data=d,main_design=main,model=model,association_tests=tests,
    odds=q2_or_table(model),nonlinearity=nonlinear,gam=gam,curves=display$curves,
    vitamin=display$vitamin,interaction=interaction,samples=samples,smooths=smooths,
    diagnostics=diagnostics,concurvity=concurvity,numeric_summary=summary_numeric,
    correlation=cor(d[c("upf_nutrient_proxy_pct10","age")]),
    proxy_usage=proxy_usage,proxy_fallback_reasons=fallback_reasons,
    proxy_sensitivity=sensitivity_odds,
    household_n=length(unique(d$household_id)))
}

q2_prediction_summary <- function(prediction, d, reps, df) {
  # Fixed out-of-fold predictions, reweighted by survey replicates.
  # These CIs omit training/tuning/fold-assignment uncertainty; do not use them
  # as definitive model-superiority tests or treat folds as independent samples.
  o <- prediction$oof
  model_columns <- c(Logistic="p_logistic",GAM="p_gam",RF="p_rf",Null="p_null")
  stopifnot(all(unname(model_columns) %in% names(o)))
  index <- match(o$source_row_id,d$source_row_id)
  stopifnot(!anyNA(index))
  wmat <- cbind(full=d$weight,as.matrix(d[,reps]))[index,,drop=FALSE]
  repetition <- if("repeat_id" %in% names(o)) o$repeat_id else o$repetition
  stopifnot(length(repetition)==nrow(o))
  estimates <- list(); tables <- list()
  for(m in names(model_columns)) {
    pp <- o[[model_columns[[m]]]]
    calc <- function(w) Reduce("+",lapply(unique(repetition),function(r) {
      use <- repetition==r
      weighted_binary_metrics(o$obese[use],pp[use],w[use])
    }))/length(unique(repetition))
    est <- vapply(seq_len(ncol(wmat)),function(j) calc(wmat[,j]),
      calc(wmat[,1]))
    estimates[[m]] <- t(est)
    ci <- q2_replicate_ci(t(est),df)
    tables[[m]] <- cbind(model=m,metric=rownames(est),ci)
  }
  comparison <- do.call(rbind,lapply(c("GAM","RF"),function(m) {
    x <- estimates[[m]]-estimates$Logistic
    cbind(comparison=paste(m,"minus Logistic"),metric=colnames(x),
      q2_replicate_ci(x,df))
  }))
  # Weighted calibration by pooled OOF risk bins; each repeat is equally represented.
  # This is not a calibrated/retrained model and is not an average-prediction ensemble.
  calibration <- do.call(rbind,lapply(names(model_columns)[1:3],function(m) {
    pp <- o[[model_columns[[m]]]]
    cuts <- unique(as.numeric(quantile(pp,seq(0,1,.1))))
    bin <- cut(pp,breaks=cuts,include.lowest=TRUE)
    do.call(rbind,lapply(levels(bin),function(g) {
      use <- bin==g
      weights <- wmat[use,1]
      obs <- colSums(wmat[use,,drop=FALSE]*o$obese[use])/colSums(wmat[use,,drop=FALSE])
      ci <- q2_replicate_ci(obs,df,"logit")
      data.frame(model=m,bin=g,n_predictions=sum(use),
        predicted=weighted.mean(pp[use],weights),observed=ci$estimate,
        low=ci$low,high=ci$high)
    }))
  }))
  list(metrics=do.call(rbind,tables),differences=comparison,calibration=calibration)
}

q2_export_results <- function(result, output_dir) {
  dir.create(output_dir,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
  tables <- list(sample_flow=result$input$flow,analysis_samples=result$samples,
    missingness=result$input$missingness,pregnancy_audit=result$input$pregnancy,
    proxy_availability=result$input$proxy_availability,proxy_usage=result$proxy_usage,
    proxy_fallback_reasons=result$proxy_fallback_reasons,
    proxy_two_day_sensitivity=result$proxy_sensitivity,
    numeric_summary=result$numeric_summary,adjusted_odds_ratios=result$odds,
    association_tests=result$association_tests,nonlinearity_tests=result$nonlinearity$tests,
    spline_knots=result$nonlinearity$knots,gam_smooth_complexity=result$smooths,
    gam_diagnostics=result$diagnostics,gam_concurvity=result$concurvity,
    adjusted_nutrient_age_curves=result$curves,adjusted_vitamin_d_prevalence=result$vitamin,
    diabetes_cells=result$interaction$cells,diabetes_tests=result$interaction$tests,
    diabetes_odds_ratios=result$interaction$odds,
    diabetes_adjusted_prevalence=result$interaction$prevalences,
    diabetes_prevalence_differences=result$interaction$differences,
    diabetes_nutrient_sensitivity=result$interaction$sensitivity,
    prediction_metrics=result$prediction_summary$metrics,
    prediction_differences=result$prediction_summary$differences,
    calibration=result$prediction_summary$calibration,
    cv_fold_metrics=result$prediction$fold_metrics,cv_tuning=result$prediction$tuning,
    cv_fold_audit=result$prediction$fold_audit)
  for(nm in names(tables)) data.table::fwrite(tables[[nm]],file.path(output_dir,paste0(nm,".csv")))
  # Only aggregate tables are exported; no survey identifiers/OOF individual records.
  checksums <- data.frame(file=basename(result$input$paths),md5=result$input$hashes)
  data.table::fwrite(checksums,file.path(output_dir,"source_checksums.csv"))
  writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()),file.path(output_dir,"session_info.txt"))
  stopifnot(identical(result$input$hashes,unname(tools::md5sum(result$input$paths))))
  invisible(tables)
}
```

```{r prediction-functions, include=FALSE}
# Q2: leakage-safe predictive comparison of logistic regression, GAM and RF.
#
# This block defines functions only; defining them does not fit a model or write a
# file. The caller supplies a cleaned, complete-case person-level data.frame.
# Participant-level out-of-fold predictions remain in memory. Export only
# aggregate tables/figures from the calling report.
#
# Required columns:
# source_row_id (unique), household_id, obese (numeric 0/1), diabetes (factor),
# vitamin_d (factor), upf_nutrient_proxy_pct10, age, sex (factor), weight (>0). The nutrient proxy
# is the mean of two valid daily SATPER + PEADDSD sums, requiring valid Day 1;
# otherwise valid Day 1 alone is used. Divide by 10. The RPWGT columns may be
# present but are deliberately NOT model predictors.
#
# All three models receive EXACTLY the same predictors and outer test rows.
# Hyperparameter selection uses weighted Brier loss in inner grouped folds.
# For each outer training set, weights are divided by their mean. This retains
# relative survey weights but avoids making the population total act like an
# enormous training sample in GAM penalisation. Predictive fitting here does
# NOT produce survey-design-adjusted coefficient tests or confidence intervals.
# In ranger, case.weights control the probability of sampling a person into a
# tree; they are not a complete implementation of survey-design inference.

weighted_binary_metrics <- function(y, p, w) {
  if (!is.numeric(y) || !is.numeric(p) || !is.numeric(w) ||
      length(y) != length(p) || length(y) != length(w) || length(y) == 0L) {
    stop("y, p and w must be non-empty numeric vectors of equal length.")
  }
  if (anyNA(y) || anyNA(p) || anyNA(w) ||
      any(!is.finite(y)) || any(!is.finite(p)) || any(!is.finite(w)) ||
      any(!y %in% c(0, 1)) || any(w < 0) || sum(w) <= 0 ||
      any(p < -1e-12 | p > 1 + 1e-12)) {
    stop("Metrics require binary outcomes, finite probabilities and valid weights.")
  }
  p <- pmin(1, pmax(0, p))
  positive_weight <- sum(w[y == 1])
  negative_weight <- sum(w[y == 0])

  # Weighted AUC = weighted probability that an obese person receives a higher
  # score than a non-obese person, with half credit for equal predicted scores.
  # Aggregating each distinct score makes tie handling exact, not order-dependent.
  ord <- order(p)
  score_group <- cumsum(c(TRUE, diff(p[ord]) != 0))
  grouped <- rowsum(
    cbind(positive = w[ord] * y[ord], negative = w[ord] * (1 - y[ord])),
    group = score_group, reorder = FALSE
  )
  controls_below <- cumsum(grouped[, "negative"]) - grouped[, "negative"]
  auc <- if (positive_weight > 0 && negative_weight > 0) {
    sum(grouped[, "positive"] *
          (controls_below + 0.5 * grouped[, "negative"])) /
      (positive_weight * negative_weight)
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  # Clipping is used only to keep log loss finite at numerical 0/1 predictions.
  safe_p <- pmin(1 - 1e-15, pmax(1e-15, p))
  predicted_class <- p >= 0.5
  c(
    auc = auc,
    brier = sum(w * (y - p)^2) / sum(w),
    log_loss = -sum(w * (y * log(safe_p) + (1 - y) * log1p(-safe_p))) / sum(w),
    sensitivity_0_5 = if (positive_weight > 0) {
      sum(w * (y == 1) * predicted_class) / positive_weight
    } else NA_real_,
    specificity_0_5 = if (negative_weight > 0) {
      sum(w * (y == 0) * (!predicted_class)) / negative_weight
    } else NA_real_,
    observed_prevalence = sum(w * y) / sum(w),
    mean_predicted_probability = sum(w * p) / sum(w)
  )
}

q2_prediction_self_test <- function() {
  # Small known answers validate unequal weights, ties and score direction.
  eq <- function(actual, expected) {
    isTRUE(all.equal(unname(actual), expected, tolerance = 1e-12))
  }
  stopifnot(
    eq(weighted_binary_metrics(c(0, 1), c(0.1, 0.9), c(2, 3))["auc"], 1),
    eq(weighted_binary_metrics(c(0, 1), c(0.9, 0.1), c(2, 3))["auc"], 0),
    eq(weighted_binary_metrics(c(0, 1), c(0.4, 0.4), c(2, 3))["auc"], 0.5),
    eq(weighted_binary_metrics(c(0, 1), c(0.5, 0.5), c(2, 3))["brier"], 0.25),
    eq(weighted_binary_metrics(c(0, 1), c(0.5, 0.5), c(2, 3))["log_loss"], log(2)),
    # First positive (weight 2) ties the first negative (weight 1) and loses to
    # the second (weight 3); second positive (weight 4) beats both negatives.
    eq(weighted_binary_metrics(c(0, 1, 0, 1), c(0.2, 0.2, 0.7, 0.9),
                               c(1, 2, 3, 4))["auc"], 17 / 24)
  )
  invisible(TRUE)
}

q2_prediction_seed <- function(seed, offset = 0) {
  as.integer((as.double(seed) + as.double(offset)) %% 2147483646 + 1)
}

q2_validate_prediction_data <- function(d) {
  required <- c("source_row_id", "household_id", "obese", "diabetes", "vitamin_d",
                "upf_nutrient_proxy_pct10", "age", "sex", "weight")
  if (!is.data.frame(d) || !all(required %in% names(d))) {
    stop("Prediction data are missing required columns: ",
         paste(setdiff(required, names(d)), collapse = ", "))
  }
  if (nrow(d) == 0L || anyNA(d[, required, drop = FALSE]) ||
      anyDuplicated(d$source_row_id) ||
      any(!nzchar(trimws(as.character(d$household_id))))) {
    stop("Prediction data must be complete with unique row IDs and known households.")
  }
  numeric_cols <- c("obese", "upf_nutrient_proxy_pct10", "age", "weight")
  if (!all(vapply(d[numeric_cols], is.numeric, logical(1))) ||
      any(!is.finite(as.matrix(d[numeric_cols]))) ||
      any(!d$obese %in% c(0, 1)) || any(d$weight <= 0)) {
    stop("Invalid numeric predictors, outcome or positive analysis weights.")
  }
  if (!is.factor(d$diabetes) || nlevels(d$diabetes) != 2L ||
      !is.factor(d$vitamin_d) || nlevels(d$vitamin_d) != 3L ||
      !is.factor(d$sex) || nlevels(d$sex) != 2L) {
    stop("vitamin_d must have 3 factor levels; diabetes and sex must each have 2.")
  }
  if (any(table(d$diabetes) == 0) || any(table(d$vitamin_d) == 0) ||
      any(table(d$sex) == 0) ||
      length(unique(d$obese)) != 2L) {
    stop("All predictor factor levels and both outcome values must be observed.")
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

q2_grouped_prediction_folds <- function(d, k, seed) {
  # Allocate entire households, approximately balancing case and non-case
  # counts. No nutrient value, vitamin D value or model prediction is used.
  # Outcome stratification is only a resampling-design step, not preprocessing.
  households <- unique(as.character(d$household_id))
  if (length(households) < k) stop("Fewer households than requested folds.")
  group <- match(as.character(d$household_id), households)
  counts <- rowsum(cbind(non_obese = 1 - d$obese, obese = d$obese),
                  group = group, reorder = FALSE)
  # rowsum(reorder=FALSE) follows first occurrence, as does match()/unique().
  stopifnot(nrow(counts) == length(households))
  set.seed(seed)
  group_order <- order(-rowSums(counts), runif(nrow(counts)))
  totals <- matrix(0, nrow = k, ncol = 2L)
  assigned <- integer(nrow(counts))
  target <- pmax(colSums(counts) / k, 1)
  initial_folds <- sample.int(k)

  for (j in seq_along(group_order)) {
    h <- group_order[j]
    if (j <= k) {
      selected <- initial_folds[j]
    } else {
      # Minimise the increase in normalised squared fold counts. This favours
      # folds short of whichever outcome is present in the current household.
      loss <- vapply(seq_len(k), function(f) {
        sum(((totals[f, ] + counts[h, ]) / target)^2 -
              (totals[f, ] / target)^2)
      }, numeric(1))
      ties <- which(abs(loss - min(loss)) < 1e-12)
      selected <- ties[sample.int(length(ties), 1L)]
    }
    assigned[h] <- selected
    totals[selected, ] <- totals[selected, ] + counts[h, ]
  }
  folds <- assigned[group]
  if (any(tabulate(folds, nbins = k) == 0L)) stop("An empty fold was created.")
  stopifnot(all(vapply(split(folds, d$household_id),
                      function(x) length(unique(x)) == 1L, logical(1))))
  folds
}

q2_prediction_split_audit <- function(train, test, repeat_id, outer_fold,
                                      inner_fold = NA_integer_) {
  overlap <- intersect(as.character(train$household_id), as.character(test$household_id))
  if (length(overlap) > 0L) stop("Household leakage detected in resampling.")
  if (length(unique(train$obese)) != 2L || length(unique(test$obese)) != 2L) {
    stop("A training/validation fold lacks an outcome class; revise the fold design.")
  }
  for (variable in c("diabetes", "vitamin_d", "sex")) {
    if (any(table(train[[variable]]) == 0)) {
      stop("Training fold lacks a predictor factor level: ", variable)
    }
    stopifnot(identical(levels(train[[variable]]), levels(test[[variable]])))
  }
  data.frame(
    stage = if (is.na(inner_fold)) "outer" else "inner",
    repeat_id = repeat_id, outer_fold = outer_fold, inner_fold = inner_fold,
    n_train = nrow(train), n_test = nrow(test),
    households_train = length(unique(train$household_id)),
    households_test = length(unique(test$household_id)),
    households_shared = length(overlap),
    obese_train = sum(train$obese), obese_test = sum(test$obese),
    diabetes_train = sum(train$diabetes == levels(train$diabetes)[2L]),
    diabetes_test = sum(test$diabetes == levels(test$diabetes)[2L]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

q2_fit_predict <- function(train, test, model, config = list(), trees = 500L,
                          seed = 3888L) {
  # Only this explicit predictor list is allowed. IDs, BMI components,
  # raw nutrient/day values, fallback flags, survey weights and replicate
  # weights can never be accidentally predictors.
  predictors <- c("diabetes", "vitamin_d", "upf_nutrient_proxy_pct10", "age", "sex")
  xtrain <- train[, c("obese", predictors), drop = FALSE]
  xtest <- test[, predictors, drop = FALSE]
  fit_weights <- train$weight / mean(train$weight)

  p <- tryCatch({
    if (identical(model, "logistic")) {
      fitted <- stats::glm(
        obese ~ diabetes + vitamin_d + upf_nutrient_proxy_pct10 + age + sex,
        family = stats::quasibinomial(link = "logit"),
        data = xtrain, weights = fit_weights,
        control = stats::glm.control(maxit = 100)
      )
      if (!isTRUE(fitted$converged) || anyNA(stats::coef(fitted))) {
        stop("Logistic model did not converge or has aliased coefficients.")
      }
      as.numeric(stats::predict(fitted, newdata = xtest, type = "response"))
    } else if (identical(model, "gam")) {
      k <- as.integer(config$k)
      if (length(k) != 1L || !k %in% c(4L, 6L)) stop("Invalid GAM k.")
      if (any(vapply(xtrain[c("upf_nutrient_proxy_pct10", "age")],
                     function(x) length(unique(x)) < k, logical(1)))) {
        stop("A numeric predictor has too few distinct values for the requested k.")
      }
      s <- mgcv::s
      formula <- stats::as.formula(sprintf(
        "obese ~ diabetes + vitamin_d + s(upf_nutrient_proxy_pct10, bs = 'cr', k = %d) + s(age, bs = 'cr', k = %d) + sex",
        k, k
      ), env = environment())
      fitted <- mgcv::gam(
        formula, data = xtrain, family = stats::quasibinomial(link = "logit"),
        weights = fit_weights, method = "REML",
        control = mgcv::gam.control(maxit = 100)
      )
      if (!isTRUE(fitted$converged) || anyNA(stats::coef(fitted))) {
        stop("GAM did not converge or has missing coefficients.")
      }
      if (!is.null(fitted$outer.info$conv) &&
          !identical(fitted$outer.info$conv, "full convergence")) {
        stop("GAM smoothing optimisation did not fully converge: ", fitted$outer.info$conv)
      }
      as.numeric(stats::predict(fitted, newdata = xtest, type = "response"))
    } else if (identical(model, "rf")) {
      xtrain$obese <- factor(xtrain$obese, levels = c(0, 1),
                             labels = c("Not obese", "Obese"))
      fitted <- ranger::ranger(
        obese ~ diabetes + vitamin_d + upf_nutrient_proxy_pct10 + age + sex,
        data = xtrain, probability = TRUE,
        num.trees = as.integer(trees), mtry = as.integer(config$mtry),
        min.node.size = as.integer(config$min.node.size),
        case.weights = fit_weights, respect.unordered.factors = "order",
        num.threads = 1L, seed = seed, write.forest = TRUE,
        importance = "none"
      )
      prediction <- stats::predict(fitted, data = xtest)$predictions
      if (!is.matrix(prediction) || !"Obese" %in% colnames(prediction)) {
        stop("RF probability output does not contain the Obese class.")
      }
      as.numeric(prediction[, "Obese"])
    } else {
      stop("Unknown prediction model: ", model)
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    stop(model, " fitting/prediction failed: ", conditionMessage(e), call. = FALSE)
  })
  if (length(p) != nrow(test) || anyNA(p) || any(!is.finite(p)) ||
      any(p < 0 | p > 1)) {
    stop(model, " returned invalid probabilities; no fallback has been substituted.")
  }
  p
}

run_prediction_comparison <- function(d, seed = 3888, outer_k = 5,
                                      inner_k = 3, repeats = 2, trees = 500) {
  for (pkg in c("mgcv", "ranger")) {
    if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
      stop("Install the required R package before running this comparison: ", pkg)
    }
  }
  integer_args <- c(outer_k, inner_k, repeats, trees)
  if (any(!is.finite(integer_args)) || any(integer_args != as.integer(integer_args)) ||
      outer_k < 2L || inner_k < 2L || repeats < 1L || trees < 1L ||
      length(seed) != 1L || !is.finite(seed)) {
    stop("Invalid seed, fold count, repeat count or tree count.")
  }
  q2_validate_prediction_data(d)
  q2_prediction_self_test()

  # Preserve the caller's random-number stream; every resampling/fitting seed
  # is separately deterministic inside the comparison.
  had_seed <- exists(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)
  if (had_seed) previous_seed <- get(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv)
  on.exit({
    if (had_seed) {
      assign(".Random.seed", previous_seed, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    } else if (exists(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)) {
      rm(list = ".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv)
    }
  }, add = TRUE)

  d <- d[order(d$source_row_id), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(d) <- NULL
  gam_grid <- data.frame(k = c(4L, 6L))
  # In exact Brier ties, the grid order favours fewer split candidates and a
  # larger terminal-node size. Both grids are fixed before validation starts.
  # Preserve the existing grid: with five predictors, mtry = 2 and 4 remain valid.
  rf_grid <- expand.grid(mtry = c(2L, 4L), min.node.size = c(40L, 15L))
  inner_trees <- min(as.integer(trees), 300L)
  predictions <- list()
  metrics <- list()
  tuning <- list()
  audits <- list()

  for (r in seq_len(repeats)) {
    outer_fold <- q2_grouped_prediction_folds(
      d, outer_k, q2_prediction_seed(seed, r * 100000L)
    )
    for (f in seq_len(outer_k)) {
      train <- d[outer_fold != f, , drop = FALSE]
      test <- d[outer_fold == f, , drop = FALSE]
      audits[[length(audits) + 1L]] <- q2_prediction_split_audit(train, test, r, f)
      inner_fold <- q2_grouped_prediction_folds(
        train, inner_k, q2_prediction_seed(seed, r * 100000L + f * 1000L)
      )
      for (j in seq_len(inner_k)) {
        audits[[length(audits) + 1L]] <- q2_prediction_split_audit(
          train[inner_fold != j, , drop = FALSE],
          train[inner_fold == j, , drop = FALSE], r, f, j
        )
      }

      selected <- list()
      for (model in c("gam", "rf")) {
        grid <- if (model == "gam") gam_grid else rf_grid
        candidate_results <- vector("list", nrow(grid))
        losses <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(grid))
        for (g in seq_len(nrow(grid))) {
          inner_p <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(train))
          for (j in seq_len(inner_k)) {
            validation_rows <- which(inner_fold == j)
            inner_p[validation_rows] <- q2_fit_predict(
              train = train[inner_fold != j, , drop = FALSE],
              test = train[validation_rows, , drop = FALSE], model = model,
              config = as.list(grid[g, , drop = FALSE]), trees = inner_trees,
              seed = q2_prediction_seed(seed, r * 100000L + f * 1000L +
                                           g * 10L + j + if (model == "rf") 500L else 0L)
            )
          }
          if (anyNA(inner_p)) stop("Incomplete inner validation prediction coverage.")
          score <- weighted_binary_metrics(train$obese, inner_p, train$weight)
          losses[g] <- unname(score["brier"])
          candidate_results[[g]] <- data.frame(
            repeat_id = r, outer_fold = f, model = model, candidate = g,
            k = if (model == "gam") grid$k[g] else NA_integer_,
            mtry = if (model == "rf") grid$mtry[g] else NA_integer_,
            min_node_size = if (model == "rf") grid$min.node.size[g] else NA_integer_,
            inner_weighted_brier = unname(score["brier"]),
            inner_weighted_auc = unname(score["auc"]),
            inner_weighted_log_loss = unname(score["log_loss"]),
            inner_folds = inner_k,
            trees = if (model == "rf") inner_trees else NA_integer_,
            selected = FALSE,
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          )
        }
        if (any(!is.finite(losses))) stop("A tuning loss is not finite.")
        best <- which.min(losses)
        selected[[model]] <- as.list(grid[best, , drop = FALSE])
        candidate_results[[best]]$selected <- TRUE
        tuning <- c(tuning, candidate_results)
      }

      # Nothing in the outer test set is used to choose parameters or thresholds.
      test_p <- data.frame(
        p_null = rep(stats::weighted.mean(train$obese, train$weight), nrow(test)),
        p_logistic = q2_fit_predict(train, test, "logistic"),
        p_gam = q2_fit_predict(train, test, "gam", selected$gam),
        p_rf = q2_fit_predict(
          train, test, "rf", selected$rf, trees = trees,
          seed = q2_prediction_seed(seed, r * 100000L + f * 1000L + 999L)
        )
      )
      predictions[[length(predictions) + 1L]] <- cbind(
        test, data.frame(repeat_id = r, outer_fold = f), test_p
      )
      for (model in c("null", "logistic", "gam", "rf")) {
        score <- weighted_binary_metrics(test$obese, test_p[[paste0("p_", model)]],
                                         test$weight)
        metrics[[length(metrics) + 1L]] <- cbind(
          data.frame(repeat_id = r, outer_fold = f, model = model,
                     n_train = nrow(train), n_test = nrow(test),
                     test_weight_total = sum(test$weight), stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
          as.data.frame(as.list(score))
        )
      }
      message(sprintf("Prediction validation complete: repeat %d/%d, outer fold %d/%d",
                      r, repeats, f, outer_k))
    }
  }

  oof <- do.call(rbind, predictions)
  oof <- oof[order(oof$repeat_id, oof$source_row_id), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(oof) <- NULL
  for (r in seq_len(repeats)) {
    obtained <- oof$source_row_id[oof$repeat_id == r]
    stopifnot(length(obtained) == nrow(d), !anyDuplicated(obtained),
              identical(sort(obtained), sort(d$source_row_id)))
  }
  stopifnot(nrow(oof) == nrow(d) * repeats,
            all(is.finite(as.matrix(oof[c("p_null", "p_logistic", "p_gam", "p_rf")]))))

  result <- list(
    oof = oof,
    fold_metrics = do.call(rbind, metrics),
    tuning = do.call(rbind, tuning),
    fold_audit = do.call(rbind, audits),
    settings = list(
      seed = seed, outer_k = outer_k, inner_k = inner_k, repeats = repeats,
      outer_trees = trees, inner_trees = inner_trees,
      predictors = c("diabetes", "vitamin_d", "upf_nutrient_proxy_pct10", "age", "sex"),
      tuning_loss = "survey-weighted Brier score",
      training_weight_normalisation = "weight / mean(training weight)",
      grouping = "household_id; approximately balanced unweighted outcome counts",
      classification_threshold = 0.5,
      gam_grid = gam_grid, rf_grid = rf_grid
    )
  )
  rownames(result$fold_metrics) <- rownames(result$tuning) <-
    rownames(result$fold_audit) <- NULL
  # Outer folds share training observations; do not treat fold/repeat scores as
  # independent data for a naive t-test or standard-error calculation. Repeat
  # spreads describe resampling stability, not population confidence intervals.
  result
}
```

```{r model-diagnostic-functions, include=FALSE}
# Lecture-inspired sensitivity diagnostics for the existing Q2 analysis.
# The analysis functions are defined earlier in this Rmd. No primary result or source data is changed.
# All returned data frames are aggregate diagnostics/model summaries; participant
# identifiers and person-level screening records remain local to this function.

q2_model_diagnostics <- function(result, k=10) {
  stopifnot(length(k)==1L,is.finite(k),k==as.integer(k),k>6L)
  k <- as.integer(k)
  d <- result$main_data
  design <- result$main_design
  reps <- result$input$reps
  n <- nrow(d)
  stopifnot(n>10L,length(reps)==60L,
    identical(d$source_row_id,design$variables$source_row_id),
    all(d$proxy_days %in% c(1L,2L)),all(is.finite(d$weight)),all(d$weight>0))
  model_formula <- stats::formula(result$model)

  # An auxiliary GLM gives the same weighted point estimate but model-based
  # covariance/influence geometry. Its standard errors are NEVER substituted
  # for the survey-replicate standard errors in the primary analysis.
  work <- d
  work$.diagnostic_weight <- work$weight/mean(work$weight)
  aux <- stats::glm(model_formula,data=work,weights=.diagnostic_weight,
    family=stats::quasibinomial(),control=stats::glm.control(maxit=100))
  stopifnot(isTRUE(aux$converged),all(is.finite(stats::coef(aux))),
    identical(names(stats::coef(aux)),names(stats::coef(result$model))),
    max(abs(stats::coef(aux)-stats::coef(result$model)))<1e-6)

  # Fox-Monette coefficient-correlation GVIF, as used for weighted GLMs by
  # car::vif. Include the intercept in fitting, then omit it from this matrix.
  # Group dummy coefficients by model term, so vitamin D contributes ONE
  # 2-df diagnostic. Do not feed survey sandwich/replicate covariance into this
  # calculation and interpret its result as pure predictor collinearity.
  # These are weighted-GLM geometry diagnostics, not survey hypothesis tests.
  mm <- stats::model.matrix(aux)
  stopifnot(identical(colnames(mm),names(stats::coef(aux))))
  assignment <- attr(mm,"assign")
  slope <- assignment!=0L
  stopifnot(qr(mm)$rank==ncol(mm),sum(!slope)==1L)
  R <- stats::cov2cor(stats::vcov(aux)[slope,slope,drop=FALSE])
  term_assignment <- assignment[slope]
  term_names <- attr(stats::terms(aux),"term.labels")
  logdet <- function(x) {
    if(nrow(x)==0L) return(0)
    z <- determinant(x,logarithm=TRUE)
    stopifnot(z$sign>0,is.finite(as.numeric(z$modulus)))
    as.numeric(z$modulus)
  }
  collinearity <- do.call(rbind,lapply(seq_along(term_names),function(j) {
    use <- term_assignment==j
    stopifnot(any(use))
    gvif <- exp(logdet(R[use,use,drop=FALSE])+
      logdet(R[!use,!use,drop=FALSE])-logdet(R))
    stopifnot(is.finite(gvif),gvif>=1-1e-8)
    data.frame(term=term_names[j],df=sum(use),GVIF=gvif,
      GVIF_adjusted=gvif^(1/(2*sum(use))))
  }))
  # The dimension-adjusted column is on a standard-error (root-VIF) scale.
  # Applying a raw VIF threshold such as 5 to this column would be misleading.
  weighted_cor <- function(x,y,w) {
    xc <- x-stats::weighted.mean(x,w)
    yc <- y-stats::weighted.mean(y,w)
    sum(w*xc*yc)/sqrt(sum(w*xc^2)*sum(w*yc^2))
  }
  numeric_correlation <- data.frame(variables="Age and combined nutrient proxy",
    unweighted_pearson=stats::cor(d$age,d$upf_nutrient_proxy_pct10),
    weighted_pearson=weighted_cor(d$age,d$upf_nutrient_proxy_pct10,d$weight))

  # Ordinary GLM Cook distances are approximations and are used ONLY to rank
  # records for sensitivity analysis. Reference lines 4/n and 2*p/n are
  # descriptive heuristics, not survey-calibrated tests or deletion rules.
  cook <- stats::cooks.distance(aux)
  leverage <- stats::hatvalues(aux)
  parameters <- length(stats::coef(aux))
  stopifnot(length(cook)==n,length(leverage)==n,
    all(is.finite(cook)),all(is.finite(leverage)),all(cook>=0),
    all(leverage>=0),all(leverage<1))
  # Fixed five-record screen, with source order breaking any exact ties.
  # Each record is omitted separately, never cumulatively or from the main fit.
  selected <- order(-cook,seq_len(n))[1:5]
  influence_screen <- data.frame(n=n,parameters=parameters,refits=length(selected),
    cook_reference=4/n,leverage_reference=2*parameters/n,
    cook_above_reference=sum(cook>4/n),
    leverage_above_reference=sum(leverage>2*parameters/n),
    max_cook=max(cook),median_cook=stats::median(cook),
    max_leverage=max(leverage),
    auxiliary_max_coefficient_difference=
      max(abs(stats::coef(aux)-stats::coef(result$model))))
  primary_se <- sqrt(diag(stats::vcov(result$model)))
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(primary_se)),all(primary_se>0))
  sensitivity <- list(cbind(omitted_rank=0L,n=n,q2_or_table(result$model)))
  change <- vector("list",length(selected))
  for(j in seq_along(selected)) {
    # Subset the existing full replicate design, preserving its scale,
    # rscales, mse flag and all 60 original replicate weights. This is an
    # actual refit, not the approximate one-step deletion behind Cook's D.
    deletion_design <- design
    deletion_design$variables$.diagnostic_keep <- seq_len(n)!=selected[j]
    deletion_design <- subset(deletion_design,.diagnostic_keep)
    stopifnot(nrow(deletion_design$variables)==n-1L,
      identical(deletion_design$scale,design$scale),
      identical(deletion_design$rscales,design$rscales),
      identical(deletion_design$mse,design$mse))
    fit <- survey::svyglm(model_formula,design=deletion_design,
      family=stats::quasibinomial())
    stopifnot(isTRUE(fit$converged),all(is.finite(stats::coef(fit))),
      identical(names(stats::coef(fit)),names(stats::coef(result$model))))
    sensitivity[[j+1L]] <- cbind(omitted_rank=j,n=n-1L,q2_or_table(fit))
    delta <- (stats::coef(fit)-stats::coef(result$model))/primary_se
    # Include all slopes (not the intercept) in the maximum summary.
    change[[j]] <- data.frame(omitted_rank=j,
      max_abs_change_survey_SE=max(abs(delta[names(delta)!="(Intercept)"])),
      proxy_change_survey_SE=unname(delta["upf_nutrient_proxy_pct10"]))
  }
  influence_sensitivity <- do.call(rbind,sensitivity)
  influence_change_summary <- do.call(rbind,change)

  # Basis-dimension sensitivity is inferential, not a new CV tuning search.
  # Both the formula and fixed knot grid receive k. Each specification retains
  # its own fixed basis across its 61 full/replicate fits; smoothing is refitted.
  # Basis matrices need not (and cannot) match across k=6 and k=10 models.
  stopifnot(all(vapply(result$gam$model$smooth,function(s) s$bs.dim==6L,logical(1))))
  high <- q2_gam_bundle(d,reps,q2_gam_formula(k=k),k=k,
    label=paste0("Main GAM basis sensitivity k=",k))
  df <- survey::degf(design)
  linear <- q2_logit_bundle(result$model,d,reps)
  display <- q2_main_curves(d,linear,high,df)
  baseline_curves <- result$curves[result$curves$model=="GAM",,drop=FALSE]
  high_curves <- display$curves[display$curves$model=="GAM",,drop=FALSE]
  baseline_vitamin <- result$vitamin[result$vitamin$model=="GAM",,drop=FALSE]
  high_vitamin <- display$vitamin[display$vitamin$model=="GAM",,drop=FALSE]
  stopifnot(identical(baseline_curves$variable,high_curves$variable),
    isTRUE(all.equal(baseline_curves$value,high_curves$value,tolerance=1e-12)),
    identical(as.character(baseline_vitamin$vitamin_d),as.character(high_vitamin$vitamin_d)))
  gam_k_curves <- rbind(cbind(basis_k=6L,baseline_curves),cbind(basis_k=k,high_curves))
  gam_k_vitamin <- rbind(cbind(basis_k=6L,baseline_vitamin),cbind(basis_k=k,high_vitamin))
  smooth_summary <- function(bundle,basis_k) {
    st <- summary(bundle$model)$s.table
    cap <- vapply(bundle$model$smooth,function(s) s$bs.dim-1L,numeric(1))
    stopifnot(nrow(st)==length(cap))
    data.frame(basis_k=basis_k,term=rownames(st),edf=st[,"edf"],
      max_edf=cap,row.names=NULL)
  }
  gam_k_smooths <- rbind(smooth_summary(result$gam,6L),smooth_summary(high,k))

  # Paired replicate changes use the same participants, averaging weights and
  # scenarios. The original 25-point 5th-95th percentile grids are reused.
  scenarios <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(baseline_curves)),function(i) {
    v <- baseline_curves$variable[i]
    value <- baseline_curves$value[i]/(if(v=="age") 1 else 10)
    setNames(list(value),v)
  })
  vd <- levels(d$vitamin_d)
  scenarios <- c(scenarios,lapply(vd,function(z) list(vitamin_d=z)))
  metadata <- data.frame(variable=c(baseline_curves$variable,rep("vitamin_d",length(vd))),
    value=c(baseline_curves$value,rep(NA_real_,length(vd))),
    vitamin_d=c(rep(NA_character_,nrow(baseline_curves)),vd))
  difference <- q2_standardise(high,d,scenarios)-
    q2_standardise(result$gam,d,scenarios)
  gam_k_differences <- cbind(metadata,q2_replicate_ci(difference,df,"identity"))
  gam_k_stability <- do.call(rbind,lapply(unique(metadata$variable),function(v) {
    change_pp <- 100*gam_k_differences$estimate[metadata$variable==v]
    data.frame(variable=v,max_abs_change_pp=max(abs(change_pp)),
      mean_abs_change_pp=mean(abs(change_pp)))
  }))

  # Dietary availability descriptions: no hypothesis tests, causal claims or
  # assumptions that agreement/differences establish MAR, MCAR or absence of
  # selection bias. Groups are defined WITHIN the primary analytic sample.
  # Both means and prevalence percentages use original biomedical weights.
  day_groups <- c("Day 1 only","Two valid days")
  diet_day_summary <- do.call(rbind,lapply(1:2,function(days) {
    x <- d[d$proxy_days==days,,drop=FALSE]
    stopifnot(nrow(x)>0L)
    data.frame(group=day_groups[days],n=nrow(x),
      weighted_share_pct=100*sum(x$weight)/sum(d$weight),
      age_mean=mean(x$age),age_weighted_mean=stats::weighted.mean(x$age,x$weight),
      proxy_mean_pct=mean(x$upf_nutrient_proxy_pct),
      proxy_weighted_mean_pct=stats::weighted.mean(x$upf_nutrient_proxy_pct,x$weight),
      female_pct=100*mean(x$sex=="Female"),
      female_weighted_pct=100*stats::weighted.mean(x$sex=="Female",x$weight),
      obese_pct=100*mean(x$obese),
      obese_weighted_pct=100*stats::weighted.mean(x$obese,x$weight))
  }))
  diet_day_vitamin <- do.call(rbind,lapply(1:2,function(days) {
    x <- d[d$proxy_days==days,,drop=FALSE]
    do.call(rbind,lapply(levels(d$vitamin_d),function(v) {
      indicator <- x$vitamin_d==v
      data.frame(group=day_groups[days],vitamin_d=v,n=sum(indicator),
        unweighted_pct=100*mean(indicator),
        weighted_pct=100*stats::weighted.mean(indicator,x$weight))
    }))
  }))
  methods <- data.frame(item=c("Collinearity","Numeric correlation","Influence screen",
    "Deletion sensitivity","GAM basis sensitivity","Dietary availability"),
    description=c(
      "Auxiliary normalized-biomedical-weight GLM coefficient-correlation GVIF, grouped by full model term. Model-based geometry, not survey inference. Adjusted GVIF is a root-VIF scale; no automatic variable deletion.",
      "Unweighted Pearson and biomedical-prior-weighted Pearson for age/proxy; descriptive, not tests of independence or full-model collinearity.",
      "Model-based approximate Cook distances/leverage from identical auxiliary GLM. Five largest Cook distances selected in advance; 4/n and 2p/n are heuristic references, not survey significance thresholds.",
      "Five independent single-person deletion svyglm refits using the original 60-replicate design. Main analysis unchanged. CI calculations condition on selected omissions; not formal tests of whether those records are invalid.",
      paste0("Main k=6 versus k=",k,"; 61 fixed-basis fits each, smoothing re-estimated. Common 25-point marginal grids and vitamin-D scenarios. Pointwise approximate replicate CIs and paired differences; no new held-out prediction claim."),
      "Within-main-sample descriptive one- versus two-valid-day comparison using biomedical weights. Different exposure precision/sample composition; cannot diagnose or correct selection bias."))
  list(collinearity=collinearity,numeric_correlation=numeric_correlation,
    influence_screen=influence_screen,influence_sensitivity=influence_sensitivity,
    influence_change_summary=influence_change_summary,gam_k_smooths=gam_k_smooths,
    gam_k_curves=gam_k_curves,gam_k_vitamin=gam_k_vitamin,
    gam_k_differences=gam_k_differences,gam_k_stability=gam_k_stability,
    diet_day_summary=diet_day_summary,diet_day_vitamin=diet_day_vitamin,
    methods=methods)
}
```

```{r rf-diagnostic-functions, include=FALSE}
# Post-validation explanation of the Q2 random forest.
# The prediction functions are defined earlier in this Rmd.
#
# These diagnostics do NOT tune/refit the modelling strategy using test outcomes.
# They reconstruct the already selected outer-fold forests, verify their original
# held-out probabilities, then explain those fixed forests. No participant-level
# data, predictions, identifiers or fitted forests are returned or written.
#
# Permutation importance measures the increase in held-out survey-weighted Brier
# loss after uniformly shuffling one predictor within each outer test fold. The
# outcome, other predictors and recipient survey weights stay fixed. This is a
# specified model-reliance perturbation, not a causal effect, a coefficient test,
# or a survey-design-adjusted inferential procedure. A negative importance can
# occur and must not be truncated or interpreted as a protective association.
#
# Partial dependence integrates predictions over the other covariates of held-out
# people, using their biomedical weights. Each person's prediction uses a forest
# that excluded their household. Integration occurs across all folds in a repeat;
# complete-repeat curves are then averaged. The common display grid uses the main
# sample's unweighted 5th--95th percentiles (no outcome information). Correlation
# can still create unrealistic covariate combinations; these are explanatory
# model curves, not causal effects or observed prevalence within a subgroup.

q2_rf_diagnostics <- function(prediction, d, seed = 3888, trees = 500) {
  helper_names <- c("q2_validate_prediction_data", "q2_prediction_seed",
                    "q2_prediction_split_audit")
  # Explicit closure lookup also works in a fresh, non-global knit environment.
  if (!all(vapply(helper_names, function(nm)
    exists(nm, mode = "function", inherits = TRUE), logical(1)))) {
    stop("Evaluate the prediction-functions chunk before computing RF diagnostics.")
  }
  if (!requireNamespace("ranger", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("The ranger package is required for RF diagnostics.")
  }
  if (length(seed) != 1L || !is.finite(seed) || length(trees) != 1L ||
      !is.finite(trees) || trees < 1L || trees != as.integer(trees)) {
    stop("Invalid diagnostic seed or number of trees.")
  }
  q2_validate_prediction_data(d)
  features <- c("diabetes", "vitamin_d", "upf_nutrient_proxy_pct10", "age", "sex")
  feature_labels <- c("Diabetes status", "Blood vitamin D category", "Combined nutrient proxy",
                      "Age", "Sex")
  n_permutations <- 20L
  n_grid <- 31L
  tolerance <- 1e-12
  if (!is.list(prediction) ||
      !all(c("oof", "tuning", "settings") %in% names(prediction))) {
    stop("prediction must contain saved OOF predictions, tuning and settings.")
  }
  settings <- prediction$settings
  if (!identical(as.character(settings$predictors), features) ||
      length(settings$outer_trees) != 1L || settings$outer_trees != trees ||
      length(settings$seed) != 1L || !is.finite(settings$seed)) {
    stop("The saved prediction settings do not match the five-predictor RF or tree count.")
  }
  oof <- prediction$oof
  oof_required <- c("source_row_id", "household_id", "obese", features,
                    "weight", "repeat_id", "outer_fold", "p_rf")
  if (!is.data.frame(oof) || !all(oof_required %in% names(oof)) ||
      anyNA(oof[, oof_required, drop = FALSE]) ||
      any(!is.finite(oof$p_rf)) || any(oof$p_rf < 0 | oof$p_rf > 1)) {
    stop("Saved OOF data lack the fields required for an exact reconstruction.")
  }
  tuning <- prediction$tuning
  tune_required <- c("repeat_id", "outer_fold", "model", "selected", "mtry",
                     "min_node_size")
  if (!is.data.frame(tuning) || !all(tune_required %in% names(tuning))) {
    stop("Saved tuning results are incomplete.")
  }
  repeats <- sort(unique(oof$repeat_id))
  expected_repeats <- seq_len(settings$repeats)
  expected_folds <- seq_len(settings$outer_k)
  if (!identical(as.integer(repeats), expected_repeats) ||
      length(expected_folds) < 2L || nrow(oof) != nrow(d) * length(repeats)) {
    stop("OOF repetition labels/coverage are inconsistent with the saved settings.")
  }
  selected <- tuning[tuning$model == "rf" & tuning$selected %in% TRUE,
                     tune_required, drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(selected) != length(repeats) * length(expected_folds)) {
    stop("Exactly one selected RF configuration is required per outer fold.")
  }

  # Leave the caller's RNG state untouched. The original modelling seed is read
  # from prediction$settings; seed here controls only diagnostic permutations.
  had_seed <- exists(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)
  if (had_seed) previous_seed <- get(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv)
  on.exit({
    if (had_seed) {
      assign(".Random.seed", previous_seed, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    } else if (exists(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)) {
      rm(list = ".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv)
    }
  }, add = TRUE)

  # The original prediction runner sorted on source_row_id before fitting.
  d <- d[order(d$source_row_id), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(d) <- NULL
  grid <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("upf_nutrient_proxy_pct10", "age"), function(v) {
    limits <- stats::quantile(d[[v]], c(.05, .95), names = FALSE)
    if (any(!is.finite(limits)) || diff(limits) <= 0) {
      stop("Cannot construct a non-degenerate PDP grid for ", v)
    }
    values <- seq(limits[1], limits[2], length.out = n_grid)
    data.frame(variable = v, model_value = values,
               value = if (v == "age") values else values * 10,
               units = if (v == "age") "years" else "energy percentage points",
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
  grid$grid_id <- seq_len(nrow(grid))
  rownames(grid) <- NULL
  loss_sum <- array(0, dim = c(length(repeats), length(features), n_permutations))
  baseline_sum <- numeric(length(repeats))
  weight_sum <- numeric(length(repeats))
  pdp_sum <- matrix(0, nrow = length(repeats), ncol = nrow(grid))
  outside_training_sum <- matrix(0, nrow = length(repeats), ncol = nrow(grid))
  validation <- list()

  predict_probability <- function(fitted, newdata) {
    probability <- stats::predict(fitted, data = newdata,
                                   num.threads = 1L)$predictions
    if (!is.matrix(probability) || !"Obese" %in% colnames(probability)) {
      stop("Reconstructed forest did not return the expected positive class.")
    }
    p <- as.numeric(probability[, "Obese"])
    if (length(p) != nrow(newdata) || any(!is.finite(p)) || any(p < 0 | p > 1)) {
      stop("Reconstructed forest returned invalid probabilities.")
    }
    p
  }

  for (ri in seq_along(repeats)) {
    r <- repeats[ri]
    saved <- oof[oof$repeat_id == r, , drop = FALSE]
    if (anyDuplicated(saved$source_row_id) ||
        !setequal(saved$source_row_id, d$source_row_id) ||
        !identical(sort(unique(as.integer(saved$outer_fold))), expected_folds)) {
      stop("OOF rows/folds do not cover the main sample exactly once in repeat ", r)
    }
    saved <- saved[match(d$source_row_id, saved$source_row_id), , drop = FALSE]
    # Detect stale caches or altered data before attempting reconstruction.
    for (v in c("obese", features, "weight", "household_id")) {
      same <- if (is.factor(d[[v]])) {
        is.factor(saved[[v]]) && identical(levels(d[[v]]), levels(saved[[v]])) &&
          identical(as.character(d[[v]]), as.character(saved[[v]]))
      } else if (v == "household_id") {
        identical(as.character(d[[v]]), as.character(saved[[v]]))
      } else {
        isTRUE(all.equal(d[[v]], saved[[v]], tolerance = 0,
                         check.attributes = FALSE))
      }
      if (!same) stop("Saved prediction data differ from current data for ", v)
    }

    for (f in expected_folds) {
      is_test <- saved$outer_fold == f
      train <- d[!is_test, , drop = FALSE]
      test <- d[is_test, , drop = FALSE]
      audit <- q2_prediction_split_audit(train, test, r, f)
      config <- selected[selected$repeat_id == r & selected$outer_fold == f,
                         , drop = FALSE]
      if (nrow(config) != 1L || !config$mtry %in% c(2L, 4L) ||
          !config$min_node_size %in% c(15L, 40L)) {
        stop("Selected RF configuration is invalid for repeat/fold ", r, "/", f)
      }
      xtrain <- train[, c("obese", features), drop = FALSE]
      xtest <- test[, features, drop = FALSE]
      xtrain$obese <- factor(xtrain$obese, levels = c(0, 1),
                             labels = c("Not obese", "Obese"))
      fit_seed <- q2_prediction_seed(settings$seed, r * 100000L + f * 1000L + 999L)
      fitted <- ranger::ranger(
        obese ~ diabetes + vitamin_d + upf_nutrient_proxy_pct10 + age + sex,
        data = xtrain, probability = TRUE, num.trees = as.integer(trees),
        mtry = as.integer(config$mtry), min.node.size = as.integer(config$min_node_size),
        case.weights = train$weight / mean(train$weight),
        respect.unordered.factors = "order", num.threads = 1L,
        seed = fit_seed, write.forest = TRUE, importance = "none"
      )
      baseline <- predict_probability(fitted, xtest)
      reconstruction_error <- max(abs(baseline - saved$p_rf[is_test]))
      if (reconstruction_error > tolerance) {
        stop(sprintf(paste0("RF reconstruction failed for repeat %d/fold %d: ",
                            "max probability difference %.16g exceeds %.1e. ",
                            "Check package versions, data and saved settings."),
                     r, f, reconstruction_error, tolerance))
      }
      fold_weight <- sum(test$weight)
      fold_baseline_sum <- sum(test$weight * (test$obese - baseline)^2)
      baseline_sum[ri] <- baseline_sum[ri] + fold_baseline_sum
      weight_sum[ri] <- weight_sum[ri] + fold_weight

      for (vi in seq_along(features)) {
        v <- features[vi]
        # Uniform permutations of held-out rows; case weights stay attached to
        # recipients. Factor indexing preserves the original factor levels.
        perturbed <- lapply(seq_len(n_permutations), function(b) {
          set.seed(q2_prediction_seed(seed, 20000000 + r * 1000000 +
                                       f * 10000 + vi * 100 + b))
          nd <- xtest
          nd[[v]] <- xtest[[v]][sample.int(nrow(xtest))]
          nd
        })
        p <- matrix(predict_probability(fitted, do.call(rbind, perturbed)),
                    nrow = nrow(test), ncol = n_permutations)
        squared_error <- sweep(p, 1L, test$obese, "-")^2
        loss_sum[ri, vi, ] <- loss_sum[ri, vi, ] +
          colSums(sweep(squared_error, 1L, test$weight, "*"))
      }

      scenarios <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(g) {
        nd <- xtest
        nd[[grid$variable[g]]] <- rep(grid$model_value[g], nrow(nd))
        nd
      })
      pdp_predictions <- matrix(
        predict_probability(fitted, do.call(rbind, scenarios)),
        nrow = nrow(test), ncol = nrow(grid)
      )
      pdp_sum[ri, ] <- pdp_sum[ri, ] +
        colSums(sweep(pdp_predictions, 1L, test$weight, "*"))
      outside <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(g) {
        observed_range <- range(train[[grid$variable[g]]])
        grid$model_value[g] < observed_range[1] ||
          grid$model_value[g] > observed_range[2]
      }, logical(1))
      outside_training_sum[ri, ] <- outside_training_sum[ri, ] +
        as.numeric(outside) * fold_weight

      validation[[length(validation) + 1L]] <- cbind(
        audit,
        data.frame(mtry = config$mtry, min_node_size = config$min_node_size,
                   trees = trees, forest_seed = fit_seed,
                   max_abs_prediction_difference = reconstruction_error,
                   weighted_baseline_brier = fold_baseline_sum / fold_weight,
                   test_weight_total = fold_weight)
      )
      message(sprintf("RF explanations complete: repeat %d/%d, outer fold %d/%d",
                      r, length(repeats), f, length(expected_folds)))
    }
    if (!isTRUE(all.equal(weight_sum[ri], sum(d$weight), tolerance = 1e-12))) {
      stop("A complete repeat did not integrate all main-sample analysis weights.")
    }
  }

  baseline_brier <- baseline_sum / weight_sum
  importance_draws <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(repeats), function(ri) {
    do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(features), function(vi) {
      permuted_brier <- loss_sum[ri, vi, ] / weight_sum[ri]
      data.frame(repeat_id = repeats[ri], feature = features[vi],
                 feature_label = feature_labels[vi], permutation = seq_len(n_permutations),
                 baseline_brier = baseline_brier[ri], permuted_brier = permuted_brier,
                 brier_increase = permuted_brier - baseline_brier[ri],
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }))
  }))
  importance_by_repeat <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(repeats), function(ri) {
    do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(features), function(vi) {
      z <- importance_draws[importance_draws$repeat_id == repeats[ri] &
                              importance_draws$feature == features[vi], ]
      data.frame(repeat_id = repeats[ri], feature = features[vi],
                 feature_label = feature_labels[vi], baseline_brier = baseline_brier[ri],
                 brier_increase = mean(z$brier_increase),
                 permutation_mc_sd = stats::sd(z$brier_increase),
                 permutation_mc_min = min(z$brier_increase),
                 permutation_mc_max = max(z$brier_increase),
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }))
  }))
  importance <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(features), function(vi) {
    z <- importance_draws[importance_draws$feature == features[vi], ]
    # Pair permutation index b across repeats only to describe the Monte Carlo
    # variation of the repeat-averaged estimate, conditional on these fixed fits.
    averaged_draws <- vapply(seq_len(n_permutations), function(b) {
      mean(z$brier_increase[z$permutation == b])
    }, numeric(1))
    repeat_means <- importance_by_repeat$brier_increase[
      importance_by_repeat$feature == features[vi]]
    data.frame(feature = features[vi], feature_label = feature_labels[vi],
               baseline_brier = mean(baseline_brier),
               brier_increase = mean(averaged_draws),
               permutation_mc_sd = stats::sd(averaged_draws),
               permutation_mc_p025 = unname(stats::quantile(averaged_draws, .025)),
               permutation_mc_p975 = unname(stats::quantile(averaged_draws, .975)),
               permutation_mc_min = min(averaged_draws),
               permutation_mc_max = max(averaged_draws),
               repeat_mean_min = min(repeat_means), repeat_mean_max = max(repeat_means),
               permutations_per_fold = n_permutations, repeats = length(repeats),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))

  pdp_repeat_matrix <- sweep(pdp_sum, 1L, weight_sum, "/")
  outside_repeat_matrix <- sweep(outside_training_sum, 1L, weight_sum, "/")
  pdp_by_repeat <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(repeats), function(ri) {
    cbind(data.frame(repeat_id = repeats[ri]), grid,
          data.frame(predicted_probability = pdp_repeat_matrix[ri, ],
                     predicted_prevalence_pct = 100 * pdp_repeat_matrix[ri, ],
                     outside_training_range_weight_fraction = outside_repeat_matrix[ri, ]))
  }))
  pdp <- cbind(grid, data.frame(
    predicted_probability = colMeans(pdp_repeat_matrix),
    predicted_prevalence_pct = 100 * colMeans(pdp_repeat_matrix),
    repeat_min = apply(pdp_repeat_matrix, 2L, min),
    repeat_max = apply(pdp_repeat_matrix, 2L, max),
    outside_training_range_weight_fraction = colMeans(outside_repeat_matrix)
  ))
  validation <- do.call(rbind, validation)
  stopifnot(nrow(validation) == length(repeats) * length(expected_folds),
            all(validation$households_shared == 0L),
            all(validation$max_abs_prediction_difference <= tolerance),
            all(is.finite(importance$brier_increase)),
            all(is.finite(pdp$predicted_probability)),
            all(pdp$predicted_probability >= 0 & pdp$predicted_probability <= 1))

  result <- list(
    importance = importance,
    importance_by_repeat = importance_by_repeat,
    importance_draws = importance_draws,
    pdp = pdp,
    pdp_by_repeat = pdp_by_repeat,
    validation = validation,
    settings = list(
      diagnostic_seed = seed, original_prediction_seed = settings$seed,
      ranger_version = as.character(utils::packageVersion("ranger")),
      trees = trees, outer_folds = length(expected_folds), repeats = length(repeats),
      predictors = features, permutations_per_fold = n_permutations,
      prediction_match_tolerance = tolerance, main_sample_n = nrow(d),
      main_households_n = length(unique(d$household_id)),
      pdp_grid = "31 points per numeric feature; unweighted main-sample 5th--95th percentiles",
      integration = "Survey-weighted complete-repeat estimates, then equal mean across repeats",
      permutation = "Uniform shuffle within held-out fold; recipient outcomes and weights unchanged",
      uncertainty = paste("Permutation MC spreads and repeat ranges are descriptive only:",
                          "not confidence intervals, significance tests or retraining uncertainty."),
      interpretation = paste("Model explanations, not causal effects or measured UPF consumption;",
                             "PDP combinations can be unrealistic when predictors are associated."),
      outputs = "Aggregate diagnostic tables only; no person-level records or fitted forests"
    )
  )
  for (nm in setdiff(names(result), "settings")) rownames(result[[nm]]) <- NULL
  result
}
```

```{r run-analysis, include=FALSE}
data_dir <- normalizePath(params$data_dir,mustWork=TRUE)
q2_prediction_self_test()
message("Fitting survey-weighted associations and GAM replicate models...")
result <- q2_compute_associations(data_dir)
message("Running household-grouped nested cross-validation...")
result$prediction <- run_prediction_comparison(result$main_data,
  seed=params$seed,outer_k=5,inner_k=3,repeats=params$cv_repeats,trees=params$rf_trees)
result$prediction_summary <- q2_prediction_summary(result$prediction,
  result$main_data,result$input$reps,survey::degf(result$main_design))
message("Checking model sensitivity and RF explanations...")
result$model_checks <- q2_model_diagnostics(result,k=10)
result$rf_checks <- q2_rf_diagnostics(result$prediction,result$main_data,
  seed=params$seed,trees=params$rf_trees)
stopifnot(identical(result$input$hashes,unname(tools::md5sum(result$input$paths))))
if(params$export_results) {
  q2_export_results(result,params$output_dir)
  for(section in c("model_checks","rf_checks")) for(nm in names(result[[section]])) {
    tab <- result[[section]][[nm]]
    if(is.data.frame(tab)) data.table::fwrite(tab,file.path(params$output_dir,
      paste0(section,"_",nm,".csv")))
  }
}
```
